grant.description: The one-time grant minted when the support session was started: 32 random bytes, base64url, no padding. Consumed atomically by this exchange — presenting it again answers the same refusal a forged one would.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose `S256` hash was sent as the grant's challenge when the session was started. Between 43 and 128 unreserved characters, RFC 7636 §4.1's charset — the same shape `oauthCodeTokenRequest.code_verifier` checks, compared rather than parsed.
